title: Money-Back Refunds Counted Across All of a Customer's Web Hosting Plans
content:
Refunds Desk Standard — Web Hosting Plans

**Counting.** Money-back refunds are counted across all of a customer's Web Hosting Plans plans together, not per plan. The count is the number of hosting refund lines of the money-back kind across all of the customer's hosting plans whose refund date falls in the trailing 365 calendar days ending today, today included.

**Former limit clause — no longer in force.** The clause "a money-back refund may be given only while the customer's count of hosting money-back refunds in the trailing 365 days is below the tier's per-customer money-back figure" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current Web Hosting Plans refund basis and is not applied as written here.

**Customer at the limit.** A customer at the limit may still cancel immediately or at term end, but without any money-back refund.

**Window illustration (hypothetical dates, a span with no 29 February).** For a today of 14 September, the trailing window runs from 15 September of the previous year through 14 September, both days included: a money-back refund dated 15 September of the previous year is counted, and one dated 14 September of the previous year is not.

| Refund line | Counted |
|---|---|
| money-back kind, on any of the customer's plans, dated within the window | Yes |
| money-back kind, dated before the window | No |
| a refund of another kind (auto-renew refund, failed order) | No |

superseded_clauses: A money-back refund may be given only while hosting_msr_money_back_365d is below money_back_per_customer_365d.
